titulo: Me at self-checkout feeling like a pro
caption:
Me at self-checkout feeling like a pro

Me at self-checkout feeling like a pro.

The machine weighs everything twice. If it complains, wait a second before you panic: it usually just heard the bag move.

Send it to the friend who has been rescued by the self-checkout attendant.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a paper bag at its right end. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and leans to slide three items across the table one by one, a bite, a bread roll and a tangerine, each one disappearing into the bag with a small beep above the table and a proud pulse. In the last second the text changes from: me at self-checkout being so efficient, to: unexpected item in the bagging area. The figure's eyes go wide as it looks down, trembling. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
